items.headline: Monet's Iris makes €50m in Paris
items.summary: A late Monet, never shown in public, became the priciest artwork ever sold at auction in France (Sotheby's, 22 October).
items.question: Which Monet became the most expensive artwork ever auctioned in France?
items.explain: Iris (1924–25) sold for €50m with fees at Sotheby's Paris, against a €22–30m estimate.

items.headline: Art Basel Paris closed two days early
items.summary: Planned protests cut the fair short in October. French galleries are now asking for compensation.
items.question: Why did Art Basel Paris close two days early in October 2026?
options: A fire at the Grand Palais
items.explain: Organisers cited weekend protests and the safety of visitors and artworks. Galleries have written asking for compensation.

reveal.title: The Grand Palais, Paris, home of Art Basel Paris

items.headline: Van Eyck's portraits reunited in London
items.summary: The National Gallery's 'Van Eyck: The Portraits' opens 21 November and runs to 11 April 2027.
items.question: Whose portraits fill the National Gallery in London from 21 November?
items.explain: The first exhibition devoted to Jan van Eyck's portraits, built around the gallery's own Arnolfini Portrait.

items.headline: Inside Bloomsbury opens at Tate Britain
items.summary: A major show on Vanessa Bell and Duncan Grant, 12 November 2026 to 11 April 2027.
items.question: Tate Britain's new exhibition focuses on which pair of artists?
items.explain: 'Vanessa Bell & Duncan Grant: Inside Bloomsbury' opened on 12 November.

items.headline: Peggy Guggenheim's London years at the RA
items.summary: From 21 November the Royal Academy looks at her Cork Street gallery, Guggenheim Jeune (1938–39).
items.question: Peggy Guggenheim's London gallery gave the first UK solo show to which artist?
items.explain: Guggenheim Jeune, at 30 Cork Street, hosted Kandinsky's first UK solo exhibition.

items.headline: New York's November sales test the top end
items.summary: Sotheby's offers a Cézanne estimated around $120m on 18 November; Christie's leads with a $60–80m Kandinsky on 17 November.
items.question: Sotheby's hopes a painting by which artist will beat his roughly $138m auction record on 18 November?
items.explain: The Cézanne record is La Montagne Sainte-Victoire, sold at Christie's in 2022 for about $138m.

items.headline: Sweden returns Benin Bronzes to Nigeria
items.summary: Swedish museums have restituted objects to Nigeria and Bolivia.
items.question: Which country's museums returned Benin Bronzes to Nigeria this month?
items.explain: Swedish museums restituted objects to both Nigeria and Bolivia in early November 2026.

items.headline: Rijksmuseum to send a Vermeer to Hong Kong
items.summary: A new partnership with the Hong Kong Palace Museum includes a 2027 show of 100 Dutch Golden Age works.
items.question: Which Vermeer will travel to Hong Kong in 2027 as part of a Rijksmuseum partnership?
items.explain: The Love Letter heads the loan. Girl with a Pearl Earring belongs to the Mauritshuis, not the Rijksmuseum.

items.headline: Venice Biennale awards on its final day
items.summary: The 61st Biennale closes on 22 November, when its postponed awards are finally given after the jury resigned in April.
items.question: When will the 2026 Venice Biennale's postponed awards be presented?
items.explain: The jury resigned on 30 April, so the May ceremony was moved to 22 November.

items.headline: A $180m Van Gogh goes under the hammer
items.summary: Sotheby's New York offers Blossoming Chestnut Trees on 18 November, hoping to beat the Van Gogh auction record.
items.question: Which Van Gogh could set his auction record at Sotheby's on 18 November?
items.explain: Painted at Auvers-sur-Oise in May 1890, it is estimated at about $180m before fees. The record is $117m, for Orchard with Cypresses in 2022.
